formula: wiki/scripts/db2-lib.mjs scaleEffect at level 60 (min/max = base x (1 -/+ variance/2) + per_level x levels past base, capped at the rank's max level); totals = per-tick x floor(duration / period)

Tauren.name: War Stomp
Tauren.wiki: active, 2 s stun nearby, 90 s cooldown (2 min before Oct 15)

Tauren.name: Endurance
Tauren.wiki: passive, +5% max health and nothing else since Oct 26 (Oct 15 to Oct 26 it also gave +2% crit damage and healing; before Oct 15, +1% hit)

Tauren.name: Cultivation
Tauren.wiki: active, grows herbs anyone can pick without Herbalism; cooldown 60 to 15 min on Oct 15

Tauren.name: Plainsrunning
Tauren.wiki: passive, run speed climbs the longer you move: 2% per stack to a 60% cap since Oct 26 (was 1% to 30%); no longer raises mounted speed (Oct 15 had added 3% mounted speed); since Oct 15 the Tauren must cover a minimum distance per second to keep it

Troll.name: Berserking
Troll.wiki: active, +10% cast and attack speed for 10 s; cooldown unpublished

Troll.name: Regeneration
Troll.wiki: passive, 20% of health regen works in combat (10% before Oct 15)

Troll.name: Rapid Regeneration
Troll.wiki: active, channel back 50% of max health; moving or damage cancels; guides say 3 min cooldown and a 6 s channel

Undead.name: Will of the Forsaken
Undead.wiki: active, removes Charm, Fear and Sleep with no immunity after; cooldown unpublished (guides say 2 min); blocked under Scatter Shot since Oct 15

Undead.name: Cannibalize
Undead.wiki: active, eat a Humanoid or Undead corpse for 35% health and mana over time

Undead.name: Touch of the Grave
Undead.wiki: passive, chance to drain health on hit or spell; Oct 15 (as Touch of the Dead): 30% proc for casters, 20% for Paladin, Rogue and Warrior, 15 s internal cooldown since Oct 27 (25 s from Oct 15), no low-rank penalty; guides say about 5% of max health drained

gloss.legacy points: Account-wide points earned by finishing challenges, spent on rewards for any character.
